missions.title: Witches' Sabbath
missions.description: "The back of a starfish hosts a strange world. Spirits gather here, and fate has led souls here too."

missions.title: The Land of Miracles
missions.description: "The spirits have each chosen a different girl, and each girl has chosen their own fate."

missions.title: Time Transfixed
missions.description: "The Reaper has fallen, yet the shadow of death still hangs over each and every soul in the Otherworld.

missions.title: The Gold of the Azure
missions.description: "A fork appears in the path. One leads to a fog-shrouded past of sorrow, the other leads to a garden where the sun always shines cheerfully."

missions.title: The Search for Truth
missions.description: "One will always have to sacrifice blood and soul in the name of protecting their truth."

missions.title: The Lost Jockey
missions.description: "Every time you think you have been backed to a corner of hopelessness, there is an even deeper despair waiting for you at the end."

missions.title: The False Mirror
missions.description: "The world chose destruction, bringing an eternal end, or perhaps a new beginning?"

missions.title: Migratory Birds
missions.description: "To reach the best ending, she travels from one world to another."

missions.title: The Harlequin's Carnival
missions.description: "In the heavy, depressive darkness, a familiar voice brings hope."

missions.title: The Blank Signature
missions.description: "A broken card has become her last hope."

missions.title: Sleep
missions.description: "When a group of long-lost friends reunite, the countdown to separation begins."

missions.title: The Birth of the World
missions.description: "Open these eyes, only to see through truth, reality, and the world."

missions.title: Fragments of Thoth I
missions.description: "A fragment of the world's truth has been revealed to you."

missions.title: Fragments of Thoth II
missions.description: "The world gradually shows you more of the truth."

missions.title: Fragments of Thoth III
missions.description: "Behind these cards a gloomy shadow is cast. Does it hide oppressive death, or bury ever deeper secrets?"

missions.title: Fragments of Thoth IV
missions.description: "You are very close to the truth behind it all."

missions.title: Fragments of Thoth V
missions.description: "You have seen all, and lost all."

missions.title: Circular Destiny
missions.description: "Through countless reincarnations and countless forgetting, only a final thought of obsession has been left for her."
